title: The Line Set: The Collected Volume
description:
A thin reader that declares what a set of small evaluative instruments is, reads available sibling packages, and reports unexempted cross-line collisions in published enum member names. It adds no instrument of its own and computes no aggregate. A reading does not establish conceptual separation or verify sibling conclusions.

Subtitle: A Declaration, a Reader, and a Non-Overlap Contract for a Growing Set of Small Instruments

Code is MIT licensed; prose and figures are CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE in the repository.
notes: Membership is declared by the package registry. Sibling DOI references are retained in related_identifiers. The last verified archive DOI is retained as an explicitly versioned historical reference in CITATION.cff and the manuscript configuration; no DOI has been assigned to this software release.
